name: tesla-pullover
description: Find a safe stop ahead and send Fleet navigation so FSD can drive there. Streamable HTTP MCP for Grok Bot and Cursor.

TESLA_MCP_URL.title: Pull-over MCP URL
TESLA_MCP_URL.description: Public HTTPS Streamable HTTP endpoint, including /mcp. Not localhost. Example: https://mcp.example.com/mcp

TESLA_MCP_TOKEN.title: Pull-over MCP token
TESLA_MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization on the HTTP MCP. Not a Tesla Fleet or Teslemetry token.
